text: I'm a business major and want to understand AI for companies, but I don't code. Any beginner book with real business examples?
I keep hearing about CRISPR in biology class. What should I read to get how gene editing works without jumping straight into lab papers?
French Revolution but from ordinary people's point of view, like daily life and not just the kings? I'm in an intro history class.
Why do prices go up and why does inflation hit some families harder? I need an economics book that's not all equations.
I'm taking intro psych and want to know what actually helps anxiety. A book that explains the research simply would help.
What should a CS student read about AI bias and people getting treated unfairly by algorithms? Not a super abstract philosophy book.
I'm a nursing student. Need a book on explaining type 2 diabetes care to patients in a way they can actually use.
How do buildings stay cool without using loads of AC? I'm starting architecture and want design examples, not heavy engineering formulas.
Estudio ciencias políticas. ¿Hay un libro sencillo que explique representación proporcional y por qué cambia los resultados electorales?
I'm new to postcolonial literature. What book gives me the history and a few novels to start with before the big theory stuff?
Ocean plastics: where does it all come from and what actually works to reduce it? Need something readable for environmental science.
I want to learn where jazz came from and the communities behind it. I can listen but can't read much music notation yet.
What does Indigenous data sovereignty mean in practice? I'm in anthropology and need a beginner-friendly book, maybe with examples.
Did Netflix and other streaming apps change what movies get made? Looking for a book with examples for a film class.
I'm good at basic math but new to stats. Is there a book on reading survey results and spotting bad conclusions without lots of calculus?
Ich studiere Chemie und verstehe Lithium-Ionen-Akkus noch nicht. Gibt es eine verständliche Einführung zur Chemie dahinter?
How do reporters check viral claims online before sharing them? I need a practical fact-checking book, not only a theory of media.
Why is rent so high in big cities and what affordable housing policies have worked? I'm new to urban studies.
I'm training to teach. Any book on helping bilingual kids in class without treating their home language as a problem?
Je commence la philo : comment comprendre le libre arbitre et le déterminisme sans me perdre dans les textes compliqués ?
During an outbreak, how do local health teams get people information and help? I want case studies for an intro public health course.
Je cherche des livres sur les femmes artistes oubliées par les musées, avec des exemples d'œuvres plutôt que de la théorie pure.
What makes a data chart misleading? I'm starting data science and want visual examples before a bunch of Python code.
Quiero entender por qué migra la gente hacia Europa y qué políticas se han probado. Soy estudiante de relaciones internacionales, nivel inicial.
Quantum computers sound cool but I haven't done advanced math yet. Is there a book that explains what they can and can't do?
In my MBA work I need to tell real sustainability strategy from greenwashing. What books use company cases and decision tools?
I'm doing an MPA capstone on transit equity. Need evidence on fares, service cuts, and who gets left behind in cities.
For my MPH project, what has actually helped public health teams talk with vaccine-hesitant communities without making distrust worse?
I need methods to evaluate RAG retrieval quality, not just chatbot examples. Any research books on search metrics and grounded answers?
For a sociology seminar, I need studies of platform gig workers: control by apps, pay insecurity, and how workers organize.
I'm in a nursing master's program. What helps family caregivers manage dementia at home, and what evidence is there for those approaches?
En mi maestría de educación especial busco intervenciones con evidencia para niños con dificultades de lectura, no consejos generales.
My architecture studio is on coastal flooding. I need books on adapting buildings and neighborhoods, with actual design cases.
How do historians read Caribbean colonial archives against the grain? I'm planning a thesis and need methods plus examples.
I need a law-level book comparing privacy risks from AI systems in the US and EU, including how rules deal with training data.
For my econ thesis, I need a solid explanation of difference-in-differences for policy evaluation, especially parallel trends and bad controls.
Pour mon mémoire en linguistique, je cherche des études sur l'alternance codique en classe multilingue et ses effets sur l'apprentissage.
I'm comparing PFAS removal in drinking water for an engineering project. Need adsorption versus membranes, costs, and limits.
I need trauma-informed social work approaches for refugees that don't assume everyone has the same experience. Any practice-focused books?
Clinical trial missing data: I need a graduate-level text on multiple imputation, sensitivity analysis, and when assumptions fail.
I'm writing a memoir that jumps around in time. Looking for a craft book on structure and voice with examples I can try.
For media studies, how do recommendation algorithms shape what people watch and believe? Need more than a basic tech explainer.
I'm researching food insecurity in cities. What books compare food banks, policy, and community-led approaches?
Para mi tesis de asuntos globales necesito libros sobre migración por cambio climático y políticas de adaptación, con casos concretos.
I'm designing an assistive robot for rehab. Need books on human-robot interaction, disability access, and how outcomes are evaluated.
I'm writing on Buddhist environmental ethics. Any books connecting religious texts with actual ecological practice in communities?
For a cyber policy seminar, I need Indigenous data governance beyond slogans: access control, consent, and who owns research data.
Je prépare un mémoire sur la restitution d'objets autochtones. Quels livres parlent des décisions des musées et du point de vue des communautés ?
I need evidence on reducing burnout in healthcare workers. Which interventions really help beyond telling staff to be resilient?
Für meine Masterarbeit suche ich Bücher zu Klimarisiken bei Banken: Kreditvergabe, Stresstests und Regulierung, gern mit Fallstudien.
